title: The Orchard of Manchester's mill district
author: Vesper Sterling
blurb: Casper Ishikawa, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
